name: Jitterbug
description: Inhabits prosthetic limbs and causes intermittent tremors — usually minor, occasionally debilitating. Born from a destroyed motor-control AI that can no longer coordinate but still tries.
observed_behavior: Introduces micro-tremors in servo motors at unpredictable intervals. Tremors worsen under stress. Sometimes stops for weeks, then returns.
location: Widespread — any district with prosthetic users
story_hooks: A sniper's prosthetic hand starts shaking during a critical shot
The tremors develop a rhythm that someone recognizes as Morse code
